_: What is on the shelf: every model the machine runs, by the repository
it is checked out from. See machine/shelf.py for how this is read, and
setup.sh for how it is fetched. A checkout lands at
<models dir>/<org>/<repo>, exactly as published, and is never changed;
`rev` pins the commit, `gb` is what it takes on disk. A newer release of
the game edits this file and nothing else: setup fetches what is
missing or at another commit, and offers to prune what nothing names.
